title: Mimicking diffusion processes with differential equations
summary: The probability-flow ordinary differential equation (PF-ODE) associated with a diffusion process is widely used in score-based generative modeling as a deterministic sampler that reproduces the marginal distributions of the diffusion. The validity of this marginal-matching property depends on the well-posedness of an ordinary differential equation whose velocity field is constructed from the score function of the diffusion.
